key_insight: An Ishikawa 6M framework links five major welding discontinuities to interconnected process factors and preventive controls.
engineering_relevance: The framework can guide welding quality management to support structural integrity, equipment reliability, and component safety.
method: Qualitative literature review and documentary analysis, emphasizing ABNT NBR ISO 3834.
Classify potential causes by Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment.
Map welding discontinuities to potential causes and preventive measures.
evidence_signal: The review identified porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut; the abstract reports no empirical validation or quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Validate the proposed cause–control links in production before assuming they reduce welding discontinuities.
paper_title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH
